SEO — Organization Settings:
Where a category's SEO settings come from when it does not set them itself. Each setting is resolved separately, so a category can take its schema template from one place and its robots directive from another.

Category first suits a catalog whose tree carries the meaning: a setting made on a category applies to it whether it was made globally or for one store view, and only a category that says nothing defers to its parent.

Store view first suits store views that carry their own SEO policy: anything set for this store view, anywhere up the tree, outranks anything set globally. With one store view the two behave identically.

Global only — this decides how store-view scope itself is resolved.
